title: SentinelReconfigurationCommand
description: Schema for MEDIATE Message M10. This message initiates a reconfiguration command from the Sentinel Reconfiguration Deployment Unit to the target Sentinel. It contains deployment information, ordered actions, security metadata, and execution status.

type.description: NGSI-LD entity type. It has to be sentinelReconfigurationCommand.

deploymentUnitId.description: Property. Identifier of the Sentinel Reconfiguration Deployment Unit sending the command.

targetSentinel.description: Relationship. Target Sentinel entity that must execute the reconfiguration command, with contextual metadata attached to the relationship.

object.description: Relationship target. Identifier of the target Sentinel entity.

ipAddress.description: Property. IP address of the target Sentinel.

timestamp.description: Property. Date and time at which the Sentinel reconfiguration command was generated.

deployment.description: Property. Deployment information associated with the reconfiguration command.

configurationId.description: List of configuration identifiers to be applied.

bitstream.description: Embedded reconfiguration bitstream payload and its metadata, used when the bitstream is transferred as a text-encoded payload inside the message instead of being resolved locally by the Sentinel from configurationId.

encoding.description: Encoding scheme used for the bitstream payload. Example: base64.

contentType.description: MIME type of the bitstream payload. Example: application/octet-stream.

fileName.description: Original file name of the bitstream.

checksum.description: Checksum of the bitstream payload, used to verify integrity after transfer.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the decoded bitstream payload, in bytes.

actions.description: Property. Ordered list of actions to be executed by the target Sentinel.

actionType.description: Type of action to be executed.

components.description: Software components affected by the action.

version.description: Version identifiers associated with firmware or hardware configuration actions.

security.description: Property. Security metadata associated with the command, kept as provided by the partner payload.

token.description: Authentication token as provided in the partner payload. Its exact usage should be clarified with the responsible partners before implementation.

encryption.description: Encryption information used for the command exchange.

status.description: Property. Current execution status of the reconfiguration command.

state.description: Current state of the reconfiguration command.
